ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)

teu: tew — cold; noun (ꜩaꜩ chi teu vpam 'thick with cold its inside'; tew is the modern word)

v: u — its; possessive prefix (Ximénez writes v), as in v xe 'its root'

e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
ꜭazlic: k'aslik — alive, living; k'as 'live' + -lik, of one root with k'aslem 'life'

are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward

cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb

vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
quel: kel — (inferred) hang; taken as 'hang' in xe quel 'they hang', after the story and Brasseur 'demeurés suspendus'; respelled by the letters
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
tacol: taqol — summoner, one who sends for; taq 'send' + -ol, agent ending
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (ke qa chak 'we defeat them', qa- 'we') · qe — us (the object after an agent noun, camol qe 'taker of us'); q- 'we, us' + e · ke — (unclear) a particle written apart before a verb, left unrendered (ke chab'iyj 'you tell'); before waj 'hide' perhaps carrying the e of ewaj (inferred) · qe — ours; q- 'we, us' + e, standing alone as 'ours' (va que 'this one of ours', ri que 'ours', of the ball); Brasseur va ke 'la nôtre'

chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
chahal: chajal — guardian, keeper; agent noun from chaj 'guard'
naquipa: naqipa — what; naqi 'what' + pa, in naquipa rumal 'why, for what reason'

xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
rahaual: rajawal — its lords, the lords of; r- 'its' + ajaw 'lord' + -al

maihah: maijaj — wonder at, marvel (inferred); after Brasseur ('était émerveillé')
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain · Junajpu — also the name of a mountain (Brasseur: the Volcán de Fuego)
xbalanque: Xb'alanke — Xbalanque; name of the second of the two boys, with Hunahpu; make-up uncertain (Brasseur: x- diminutive + balam 'jaguar')
cate: k'ate — then, only then; narrative particle

ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb

chuxic: chuxik — it shall be; ch- + ux 'become' + -ik, said after a speech, beside chuxoq 'let it be'

puquih: pukij — (inferred) scatter, spill over; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'se remplit … la tête d'échardes de bois'; respelled by the letters
bac: b'aq — bone; noun (ca bac 'our bones', the teeth) · b'aq — (guess) make fire, strike fire; a verb with the letters of b'aq 'bone' (xki b'aq ki q'aq' 'they made their fire', Brasseur 'battirent du feu')

ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered
xu: xu — it (did); x- completive + u- 'it', singular of xki
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x · k'ux — (inferred) gnaw, saw; the letters of k'u'x 'heart' as a verb (ca ꜭux qui he 'gnawing their tails'), after Brasseur 'scier'

varanel: waranel — (inferred) watchers; war 'sleep' + -an + -el, those who keep the night (Brasseur 'veilleurs')

xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
el: el — go out; verb (kat el 'you go out')
apa: apa — where; interrogative adverb, asks the place · apa — who; in apa china 'who (are they)', where the pair is read together (inferred)
chupam: chupam — inside, within; chi + u- 'its' + pam 'inside' (the m spelling of chupan)
ꜫaꜫ: q'aq' — fire; noun (pa ꜫaꜫ 'in the fire') · q'aq' — red (Brasseur cak 'rouge'); the same tresillo letters as 'fire'; the modern word is kaq, the toggle respells the letters

tiyic: tiyik — were eaten (uncertain); doubtful reading, perhaps ti' 'eat' + -ik, sense guessed from Brasseur's French
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written · ya — put, set; the 'give' verb used of placing a thing (qui ya 'they put it', chi ya chuvi ꜫaꜫ 'put it on the fire')

xpe: xpe — it came; x- completive + pe 'come'
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
ꜩonoh: tz'onoj — ask, ask for; transitive verb (modern tz'onoj), the word certain; the manuscript has the plain tz ligature
acab: aq'ab' — night; written with plain c, where the house word is aꜫab; the toggle restores the q'
ꜭha: ch'a — says, said; ch'a 'say' (ca ꜭha 'he says', ca- ongoing; Ꜭha 'says' closing a speech) · ch'a — (guess) say (it)!, the bare root as a command (Ꜭha chic 'say it again'); Brasseur 'C'est dit!'

mahabi: majab'i — there is not, not yet; negative particle
ꜩam: tzam — nose, beak tip (the macaw's great beak); noun · tzam — tip, end (tzam uteleb' 'the tip of his shoulder')
xcha: xcha — said; x- completive + cha 'say', the singular of xecha
zaquiric: saqirik — it dawned; saq 'white' + -ir + -ik (dawn, in a couplet with xꜫec)
vilo: wilo — I see it; w- 'I' + il 'see' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb

xcupix: xkupix — was caught, was seized (inferred); x- + kup + -ix, passive

on: on — perhaps; particle (in xa on 'only perhaps')
xbec: xb'ek — he went; x- completive + b'e 'go' + -k
co: k'o — there is; existential verb (written co in k'o wi lo)
catecut: k'atek'ut — then; k'ate 'then' + k'ut written as one word
xca: xqa — we (did it); x- completive + qa- 'we', subject of a transitive verb
xbe: xb'e — he went; x- completive + b'e 'go'
hom: jom — ball court; noun, the walled alley of the ball game (Brasseur: the hall of the ball game, Nahuatl tlachco)
vꜩih: utzij — its word; u- 'its' + tzij 'word', possessed noun

ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
ziz: sis — (inferred) coati; Brasseur 'Porc-Epic'; written with z for s

xuꜩonoh: xutzonoj — he asked; x- completive + u- 'he' + tzonoj 'ask'
quecha: kecha — their food; ki- 'their' (qu- before a vowel) + echa 'food'; possessed noun · kecha — they say; ke- 'they' + cha 'say', written with plain ch where queꜭha has the cuatrillo, as the cacha of earlier parts; mt by the letters
naqui: naqi — what; interrogative, written with pa as naqi pa 'what is it'
ivecha: iwecha — your food; iw- 'your (pl.)' (i- before a vowel) + echa 'food'

bec: b'ek — go; b'e 'go' with -ek (inferred), as in kat b'ek 'you go'
camol: k'amol — taker, one who takes; k'am 'take' + -ol, agent ending

cama: kama — taking, take (inferred); from k'am 'take', perhaps with a nominal ending; the toggle respells the letters
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
halahoh: jalajoj — different, of many kinds; adjective

coc: kok — (inferred) smell, fragrance; after Brasseur ('commencé à sentir l'odeur'); respelled by the letters

xul: xul — it arrived; x- completive + ul 'arrive'
xuꜩinic: xutzinik — it came right, succeeded; x- completive + utzin 'succeed, complete' (from utz 'good') + -ik
xvachinic: xwachinik — it took shape, bore fruit; x- completive + wachin 'bear fruit, show itself' (from wach 'face') + -ik · xwachinik — he showed himself, he appeared
xꜭhauic: xch'awik — it spoke; x- completive + ch'aw 'speak' + -ik
vuch: Wuch' — opossum; noun, part of the name Junajpu Wuch' 'Hunahpu Opossum'
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
mama: mama — grandfather; noun · mama — old man; noun
cahmul: kajmul — four times; kaj 'four' + mul 'times' (chu kajmul 'at the fourth time', chi + u- 'its' + kajmul)
cac: kak — (uncertain) meaning not known; the letters respelled. Brasseur takes it as ac 'fowl, turkey' · q'aq' — fire; noun, ꜫaꜫ written with plain c (chuvi cac 'on top of the fire') · kak — (doubtful reading) before caracoh, where Brasseur reads zak 'white'; perhaps a slip for zac; left out of the English · kaq — red; the modern word, which these letters spell with nothing restored (cac che 'red tree'; Brasseur cak, his k being q); ꜫaꜫ 'red' with tresillos is respelled q'aq'
tiquiba: tikib'a' — plant, begin (inferred; 'planting the day' taken as laying out the count of days); verb, as in xchiqatikib'a' in the preamble
cha: cha — said, say; quotative root (uncertain in this phrase 'cha ta k'ut') · cha — at your; chi 'at' + a- 'your' (cha mox 'at your left', cha wi ki q'ab' 'at your right'), inferred · cha — (guess) arrow point, flint; after Brasseur's note (cha 'the word, the arrow, and the point of the arrow, obsidian or flint'), in xa kolokik cha 'only a round flint (?)' · cha — (inferred) blade, obsidian edge, as the arrow point above (chi cha 'of the blade') · cha — you (command); ch- + a- 'you' before a verb (cha coto 'you dig') · cha — (inferred) play, game, the ball court; chaah 'play' written with one a (xcah cut qui cha 'their game began', chi cha 'at the ball court'); Brasseur takes it as 'lances'
ban: b'an — do, make; root of the verb, here with x- completive and ki- 3pl: 'they did'
ꜩih: tzij — word, speech, account; noun · tzij — (inferred) kindle, light; xqui ꜩih ri chah 'they lit the torch', as 010's ꜩihom 'lit'
pixaban: pixab'an — (inferred) counselled; pixab' 'counsel' + -an (xe pixaban quib 'they counselled one another')
mana: mana — not; negative, a form of ma
chaahic: chaajik — playing, they played; chaaj 'play (ball)' + -ik, the ending of an intransitive verb (xe chaajik 'they played', ke chaajik 'they are playing')
banouic: b'anowik — do, did it, with the doers named; b'an 'do' + -ow, the ending that names the doers, + -ik, as xb'anowik (xe b'anowik 'they were the ones who did it')
pixabah: pixab'aj — (inferred) charge, counsel; pixab' 'counsel, command' + -aj; used with kan to 'leave a charge behind' · pixab'aj — (inferred) call out, summon, with ub'ik 'thither' (xke qa pixab'aj ub'ik 'we shall call them out'), after Brasseur 'nous les appellerons'
vmul: umul — rabbit, hare; noun, with u- part of the word
cat: kat — you (one) shall; k- 'shall' + at 'you', singular of kix · kat — you (one), of what is going on; k- 'ongoing' + at 'you' (kat b'e 'you are going') · kat — (inferred) then, so; taken as k'ut written cat (keje' kat 'so then', Brasseur quehecut), the letters respelled · k'at — burn; verb (xk'at 'it burned'), the root of k'atanalaj 'burning hot'; not kat 'you (one)' · kat — carrying net (Brasseur 'filet'); noun, written with plain c, the same letters as kat 'you' · kat — (inferred) cut; in xu ca cat 'it cut it', written with plain c (Brasseur gat 'cut'), after 'le Rat alla couper'; respelled by the letters
xuꜭhax: xuch'ax — he was told; x- completive + u- + ch'a 'say' + -x (passive), without its -ik
chopon: chopon — he arrives (there); ch- + opon 'arrive (there)' (Brasseur ch'opon)
quic: kik' — blood; noun, the known word, with the ejective restored (Brasseur quiq) · kik' — (inferred) rubber, the ball of rubber; the same word as 'blood', after Brasseur ('balls of elastic gum')
elic: elik — going out, coming out; el 'go out' + -ik
cabichal: kab'ichal — (uncertain) meaning not known; paired with telen, the pair read 'on the shoulder' after Brasseur; the letters respelled · kab'ichal — (inferred) the two of them, together; after Brasseur 'à l'un ou à l'autre'
chaah: chaaj — play (inferred, perhaps at ball); after Brasseur's note 'to play'; the sense is inferred · chaaj — also the ball, the thing played with; ri chaaj in rij kik' ri chaaj 'the surface of the rubber of the ball', after Brasseur 'la gomme de la balle avec laquelle ils jouaient'
xi: xi — x- completive + i(n) 'me', the absolutive object, with the n not written (inferred); written apart before the ergative prefix and verb · xi — you (pl.) (did it); x- completive + i- 'you (pl.)', the ergative, before a transitive verb (xi b'ano 'you did it') · xi — I; x- completive + i(n) 'I' as the subject of an intransitive verb (xi petik 'I came'), the n dropped, after Brasseur's note ('le n étant retranché par euphonie') · xi — (inferred) x- completive + i(x) 'you (pl.)', the absolutive object, with the x not written, said to one person out of respect (mi xi tiouic 'what has bitten you'); after Brasseur 'quoi donc vous a piqué'
yao: yao — give; ya 'give' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xu yao 'it gave')
ziquin: sik'in — call, shout; verb (modern sik'in), the verb of sik'ij
cul: kul — it comes; k- 'ongoing' + ul 'come, arrive here' · kul — coat, smear (inferred); xki kul sajkab' 'they coated (it) with white earth', after Brasseur ('frottèrent') · kul — (uncertain) throat, neck, in chi kul 'at the throat' after Brasseur; perhaps the cul of ukulel · Kul — (inferred) throat, gorge, in the name of the ravine Nusiwan Kul (Brasseur 'ma ravine de gorge') · kul — (doubtful reading, guess) cloth; in pa cul 'in a cloth', the l could be read t, after Brasseur qul 'mouchoir'; the modern k'ul is a blanket; respelled by the letters · kul — meet, come upon; xu kul 'it met it', the verb of xkulutaj 'was met', after Brasseur 'il rencontra'
tacal: takal — set, come to rest (inferred); said of alighting, striking, landing; sense inferred from the setting
chuvach: chuwach — on the face of; chi + u- 'its' + wach 'face', relational noun
xelic: xelik — it came out; el 'go out' + -ik, with x- completive (xelic xcul pa zel 'it came out and ran into the bowl')
xel: xel — it went out, they went out; x- completive + el 'go out', with no -ik because more follows in the clause
huminic: juminik — (guess) clamouring, raising a tumult; not otherwise known, paired with miknojik; after Brasseur ('who raise such a tumult')
chirih: chirij — behind it; chi + r- 'its' + ij 'back', relational noun · chirij — (inferred) on, over (the surface of); chi + r- 'his' + ij 'back, surface' (chirij uwach 'on his face')
quiz: k'is — finish, end; verb (xki k'is 'they finished') · k'is — (inferred) completely, all; the verb k'is 'finish' as an adverb (k'is yakatajinaq chik 'all had risen up again')
petoc: petoq — come; pet 'come' + -oq, after kix 'you (pl.)' in a command
rico: riqo — they found; root riq 'find'; xe riqo kib' 'they found each other', i.e. agreed (exact form uncertain) · riqo — find, in chu riqo 'let it find' (ch- + u- 'it') · riqo — found, with a person before it: xa riqo 'you found it', xnu riqo 'I found it'
xquilo: xkilo — they saw (it); x- completive + ki- 'they' + il 'see' + -o, ending of a transitive verb · xqilo — we saw (it); x- completive + q- 'we' (the form of qa- before a vowel) + il 'see' + -o
hunam: junam — alike, the same; jun 'one' + -am (inferred); Brasseur 'of the same kind'
re: re — of, belonging to; relational particle · re — his teeth; r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · re — (guess) teeth, gums; chawa re xpeq 'the gums of the toad' (Brasseur 'les gencives du Crapaud'), with re read as the e 'tooth' word; the division is doubtful · re — (inferred) this (one); a demonstrative before ba (Re ba chi ca coh 'this one we shall put in play'), the sense from the setting
chacatahic: chakatajik — being brought low; the verbal noun of chakataj 'bring low' (inferred), as in vchacatahic
xban: xb'an — it was done; x- completive + b'an 'do, make' passive
